source_row.extraction_instructions: ASP.NET list, one long page (1.5 MB incl. archive). Only the #tab1 'Future Events' tab is read: table per event with day/month badge, link /events/<cat>/<id>/<slug>, bold date line, optional organiser website. Detail: h1 lblTitle, blue line '(dd/mm/yyyy - dd/mm/yyyy) / Venue, City, , Country', website link, announcement PDFs, body text. No fees published; organiser website becomes organiser_url.

concerns: Listing: only the 'Future Events' tab (#tab1) of /events is read: 4 events (Zileli course, Chicago skull base course, 2027 International Neurosurgical Oncology Congress, WFNS 2027 World Congress, Bali). Shell counts normal and forced-fallback both 4. The 1.5 MB page also holds the past archive in #tab2 (never read). wfns.info (blog) ignored. The menu also has per-category pages (/events/14 Official, /events/17 Endorsed, /events/18 International); only the 'All Events' page was read, and the 4 future events found there all sit under /events/14 (Official), so a category-only listing missing from All Events is unproven.
Relevance: every event is neurosurgery for clinicians; webinars would be kept; only administrative titles (AGM, general assembly, committee/board meetings) are dropped and logged. None today.

Fees: WFNS publishes none (only announcement/brochure PDFs and an organiser website); pricing_tiers=[] justified against the page text, the file links and the organiser site (set as organiser_url; discovery followed spinalkurs.org with identity strong in a scratch run and found no fee there, its registration page is weak identity and was rejected, fail-closed). WFNS 2027 Bali: wfns2027bali.org set as organiser_url, no venue name published (city Bali only).

Abstract info is parsed from the page's own lines with abstract_classifier.classify_submission (the harness otherwise reports SUBMISSION_NO_DEADLINE because the pipeline classifier runs after the extractor).

HQ LESSON #95: regexes accept single or double quotes (WFNS raw HTML uses single quotes, the rendered DOM double); extract_detail reads page.content() (the rendered DOM the pipeline sees) and only falls back to fetch_html when the page lacks the markup.
Terms/robots: wfns.org/robots.txt is a 404 (no rules); site footer has only Cookie and Privacy policies, no terms of use or automation clause found.
Taxonomy ask: society code 'WFNS' (World Federation of Neurosurgical Societies, international, global) in societies.ts. Specialty fixed to 'Neurosurgery'.
Requests to wfns.org over development + both harness runs: about 20, sequential.
